div.p: Grice Alley is located between William Street and Queen Street, Bourke Street and Little Bourke Street. It extends to the east off William Street through to Little William Street. The buildings on the southern side of Grice Alley were once occupied by Goldsbrough Mort & Co., the leading wool-broking firm in nineteenth-century Victoria.
